# Support

Thanks for using Concerto — a local-first, policy-governed AI coding agent.
The project is **pre-release**: behavior can change between builds, and the
fastest path to a good answer is a precise question.

## Where to ask

| Need | Place |
|------|-------|
| Help getting started, "how do I ...?" | [GitHub Discussions](../../discussions) (Q&A category) |
| Something is broken | [Bug report](../../issues/new/choose) issue template |
| Idea or improvement | [Feature request](../../issues/new/choose) issue template |
| Security vulnerability | **Never** in public — follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) |

## Before asking

These documents answer most orientation questions:

- [README](../README.md) — what Concerto is, current status, quick start
- [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md) — how to build, test, and report effectively
- [TESTING](../TESTING.md) — automated checks and the manual release verification sheet
- [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md) — crate layout and design flow
- [SECURITY_BOUNDARIES](../SECURITY_BOUNDARIES.md) — threat model, policy gates, plugin sandboxing

When reporting problems, include the commit/version, OS, frontend (desktop or
CLI), provider/model, and sanitized logs. Never paste API keys, private
project content, or unredacted prompts.

## Response expectations

Concerto is maintained by a small team on best-effort timing; there is no SLA.
Discussions and issues are triaged as capacity allows — a clear reproduction
steps ahead of anything else.
